direction: Original Dungeons & Dragons / NetHack-inspired dungeon explorer. User requested a complete redesign ignoring the previous concept; no reference images were supplied.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a completely NEW costume concept sheet for a rogue player class in a realistic fantasy dungeon-crawling RPG. This is design exploration before 3D modeling.
Primary request: Invent an original Dungeons & Dragons / NetHack-inspired ROGUE, with the spirit of a resourceful low-level dungeon explorer, burglar, trap-finder and treasure hunter from classic tabletop fantasy and old-school roguelikes. IGNORE ALL PREVIOUS IMAGES AND DESIGNS in this conversation; do not reuse the previous slick black leather outfit, crossed chest harness, rivet rows, gloves, boots, face, poses or sheet arrangement. No reference images are supplied. Design freely and cohesively; this is a genuinely fresh silhouette and palette.
Character: one adult male human rogue, lean, wiry and nimble rather than a muscular hero, approximately 30 years old, expressive angular weathered face, slight beard stubble, tousled dark auburn hair, shrewd but approachable expression. A survivor who studies locks and maps, not a glamorous assassin. Original fictional character, no copying any established franchise character.
Costume design: weathered moss-and-olive green hood worn DOWN around the neck, attached to a compact asymmetrical shoulder cowl covering one shoulder and ending at the upper chest/back; no long cape. Soft faded flax/oatmeal linen shirt with sleeves rolled to just below the elbows, readable woven cloth. Over it a short battered muted oxblood / reddish russet leather jack, side-laced rather than center-buckled, practical irregular overlapping protective panels, low round neckline, one modest padded shoulder, hand repairs and neatly patched wear; a flexible leather vest, not metal plate or a corset. Its hem ends at the waist and does not become a skirt or coat. A muted mustard-ochre short cloth waist wrap just visible beneath a single utility belt. Slate blue-gray woven trousers with a little ease around the thighs, knees repaired with toned darker fabric, narrowing into practical soft weathered umber ankle boots with folded cuffs and simple side closures. The boots stop just above the ankle, suited to quiet footfalls, no knee-high lace-up boots. One fitted half-finger leather glove and the other bare hand with a short linen wrist wrap, suitable for nimble lock work. No large chest X straps, no double row of silver rivets, no all-black color scheme. Brown is a supporting material, not the whole palette.
Functional storytelling is restrained and organized: three small worn belt pouches of different shapes, a short sheathed utility dagger on the hip, a compact leather roll for lockpicks attached tightly to the opposite hip, a small coiled rope behind one hip, a single small dull brass key. All secured close to the body and clearly separated, not excessive belts or hanging clutter. One small flat map wallet. No oversized weapons, skulls, spikes, glowing magical gadgets, modern tactical armor or firearms. No robe, skirt, long coat or long cape.
Composition: one beautiful landscape production concept sheet on warm parchment-ivory background, subtly textured but uncluttered. LEFT TWO-THIRDS: a large full-body three-quarter FRONT hero view of this rogue in a relaxed alert standing pose, feet entirely visible, one hand loosely resting near a belt pouch and the other relaxed, head uncovered so the face reads. RIGHT THIRD: a smaller full-body three-quarter REAR view of EXACTLY THE SAME person, costume and color design, showing the short cowl, vest back, belt gear and trouser-to-boot division. Give both figures ample space, no overlap. At bottom right, a very small tasteful row of five painted material swatches (moss green, flax linen, oxblood leather, slate blue-gray, ochre cloth), no labels. No extra character alternatives, no separate oversized vest product shot, no text, captions, logos or watermarks.
Style: sophisticated hand-painted realistic fantasy game concept art, classic tabletop adventure-book warmth with modern production clarity. Expressive brushwork with crisp costume construction, visible material distinction, natural proportion and recognizable silhouettes, soft neutral daylight, detailed but not photorealistic product photography. Earthy nuanced color, practical starter equipment, personality and lived-in fantasy. Beautiful original design that reads as a rogue through equipment and light-footed practicality, rather than through all-black assassin clichés. Preserve clear boundaries between short upper garment, trousers, gloves and ankle boots to support eventual modular modeling. This is a costume concept only, not a 3D render or modeling sheet.
